name: Tiger
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 p. 265, Tiger Traits. Saber-Toothed Tiger cross-reference on p. 262.
heading: Tiger Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
sourceDistinctions: Saffron uses the common tiger form. Saber-Toothed Tiger redirects to the same printed traits, including Medium size.
Pounce is the 2014 shove contest, not an encounter Strength-save ability. The printed Bite and Claw explicitly qualifies for finesse requirements.

name: Weasel
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Weasel Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
sourceDistinctions: Giant Weasel uses a separate player block. Hush uses the ordinary weasel in its winter coat.
The design suggestion to grant an extra skill or feat was not selected. Hush has no printed climb, burrow or darkvision trait.

name: Winter Wolf
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Winter Wolf Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
sourceDistinctions: Rime uses the Medium player form with 40-ft. walking speed. The player block gives no darkvision, cold immunity or Pack Tactics.
Reckless Attack applies to Strength-based melee attack rolls, not the breath saving throw.

name: Wolf
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 p. 268, Wolf Traits. Dire Wolf cross-reference on p. 229.
heading: Wolf Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
sourceDistinctions: Alder uses the ordinary wolf. The printed player block omits any special bite die and does not include a No Hands paragraph, although the design notes discuss both. The NPC is a handless quadruped and uses Monk damage for ordinary unarmed body strikes.
The encounter wolf’s passive Pack Tactics and bite are separate from the player rules.

name: Worg
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Worg Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
sourceDistinctions: The design notes mention a d8 unarmed strike, but the player trait block does not grant one. Gravel uses ordinary Monk unarmed damage. No Pack Tactics or innate Common.
